function: Downlink digital precoding at a massive MIMO LEO satellite, maximizing energy efficiency, with an end-to-end GNN and a GNN-based deep unfolding of Dinkelbach and WMMSE, p. 1, 5-10.
system: LEO satellite downlink, 8x8 UPA (64 antennas), K=10 single-antenna users, fully digital precoder, statistical CSI, 2 GHz carrier, 20 MHz bandwidth, p. 3, 11.
method: Edge-update GNN and GNN deep unfolding of Dinkelbach and WMMSE with Taylor-expanded matrix inverse; unsupervised training on negative energy-efficiency loss with Adam, p. 6, 10, 11.
data_channel: Own parametric LEO channel (path gains, Doppler, delay, array response; Eq. 1-3), MATLAB-generated; 10,000 training and 1,000 test channel matrices, p. 3, 11.
test_conditions: Trained at Nt=64; deployed zero-shot with varying numbers of users, K=8 to 24 (Fig. 12); other sweeps over antennas, power budget and estimation error, p. 11-13.
baselines: Non-learned: WMMSE, RZF, MMSE (instantaneous CSI). Learned: linear deep unfolding designed after [40]; own end-to-end GNN and GNN deep unfolding, p. 11-12.
metrics: Energy efficiency (Mbits/Joule), EE histogram over 1,000 samples, execution time, EE versus power, antennas, users and estimation error, p. 11-13.
complexity: GNN order O(L m e), p. 6-7; FLOP count and reduction from O(KNt^3) to O(KNt^2), p. 11; execution time versus users and antennas, Figs. 8-9, p. 12.
q1_support: p. 3: "the frequency response of the complex baseband channel at frequency f can be expressed as [38]", an own parametric LEO model (Eq. 1-3), MATLAB-generated (p. 11). QuaDRiGa [43] is cited only for identical path angles (p. 4); no 3GPP TR 38.811 simulator or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "fixed-parameter system implementation (trained at Nt = 64 antenna configuration) with zero-shot deployment across varying user scales" (Fig. 12, K from 8 to 24; Table I lists K = 10).
q3_support: p. 11: "A deep-unfolding NN termed linear deep unfolding" (after [40]) as learned baseline and "regularized zero forcing (RZF) and minimum mean square error (MMSE)", plus WMMSE (p. 12); all compared on energy efficiency in Figs. 10-12.
q4_support: p. 11: "The total FLOP count for the GNN amounts to" a sum over layers, and a reduction "from O(KNt3 ) to O(KNt2 )"; p. 12: Figs. 8-9 report execution time against users and antennas.
q5_support: p. 11: "We run 10000 channel matrices in the train set and 1000 channel matrices in the test set", from "MATLAB-generated.mat files"; self-generated channels, no code or data link, no public dataset or measured data.
notes: Included, area 6 since the learned precoder serves a LEO satellite downlink (6 outranks 3 by specificity). Learned baseline 'linear deep unfolding' is designed by the authors following [40] (p. 11), flagged for the reviewer. Training K is not stated in the text; Table I lists K=10.
